import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
cincinnati = ee.Geometry.Point([-84.5120, 39.1031])  # Cincinnati, Ohio

# Define February months for each year
years = list(range(2010, 2019))  # 2010 to 2018
feb_temps = {}

# 2. Data Acquisition & Processing
for year in years:
    start_date = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 2, 1)
    end_date = start_date.advance(1, 'month')
    
    # Get ERA5-Land monthly data for February
    col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filterBounds(cincinnati)
    
    # Check if collection is empty
    count = col.size().getInfo()
    if count == 0:
        print(f"February {year}: No data")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()
    
    # Get temperature image (in Kelvin)
    temp_img = col.first().select('temperature_2m')
    
    # Calculate mean temperature over region
    temp_k = temp_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=cincinnati,
        scale=10000,  # ERA5-Land resolution ~9km
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('temperature_2m')
    
    temp_val = temp_k.getInfo()
    
    # Validate temperature value
    if temp_val is None:
        print(f"February {year}: Calculation failed")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        exit()
    
    # Convert from Kelvin to Celsius
    temp_c = temp_val - 273.15
    feb_temps[year] = temp_c
    
    # Print intermediate result
    print(f"Feb {year}: {temp_c:.2f}°C")

# 3. Comparison Logic
if len(feb_temps) < 9:  # Should have 9 years (2010-2018)
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# Get 2018 temperature and max of 2010-2017
temp_2018 = feb_temps[2018]
temps_2010_2017 = [feb_temps[y] for y in range(2010, 2018)]
max_2010_2017 = max(temps_2010_2017)

# Print comparison
print(f"\n2018: {temp_2018:.2f}°C")
print(f"Max 2010-2017: {max_2010_2017:.2f}°C")

# 4. Validation & Final Answer
# Check if temperatures are in reasonable range for Cincinnati February
# Typical range: -20°C to 15°C
if any(temp < -30 or temp > 20 for temp in feb_temps.values()):
    print("Temperature out of expected range")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif temp_2018 > max_2010_2017:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
